cat src/trailhead/geo.py src/trailhead/report.py; grep -rn "heading\|initial_bearing\|compass" src tests | grep -v "^src/trailhead/geo.py\|^src/trailhead/report.py"
cat tests/test_report.py; grep -rn -i "loop\|heading" README* docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "summary\.\|Summary" src | grep -v report.py

python - <<'EOF'

p=pathlib.Path("src/trailhead/report.py"); s=p.read_text()

EOF
